stages.label: Hiring manager
stages.notes:
Rota onboarding: shadow for two weeks, then paired, then alone with a named backup.
Relocation: staying in Halifax; travel to the hub is fine.
stages.outcome: Imre pressed on data ownership between Settlements and Quoting; expect it again with more depth.
stages.nextSteps: Technical round within two weeks; an exercise on idempotent payouts was promised.

transcripts.title: Hiring manager call
transcripts.text:
10:02:10 --> 10:02:24
Interviewer: when two teams both need the same payout record, who should own it

10:02:27 --> 10:02:58
Me: one team writes it and the other reads it through a contract, at Quotewright the quote state had one owner

10:03:02 --> 10:03:15
Interviewer: and how would you bring a new engineer into the on-call rota

10:03:18 --> 10:03:40
Me: shadow for two weeks first, then paired, then alone with a named backup

10:41:05 --> 10:41:20
Interviewer: the technical round is next, expect a question on idempotent payouts

stages.label: Technical
stages.notes:
Live coding plan: read the repository's tests first; narrate each step; small commits; say when AI wrote a line.
Data ownership: one writer per table; Settlements owns payout state; Quoting reads it through a contract. Proof: Quotewright, server-owned quote state.
Whiteboard opener: draw the payout workflow before any box for a service.

employerSaid.said: The technical round is two hours: one hour of live coding on a shared NestJS and React repository, then one hour of system design.
References are taken only after an offer is agreed.
The panel cares most about correctness under retries.

research.title: Settlements engineering notes
research.text:
# Settlements engineering notes
The settlement ledger is append-only and balanced nightly against bank files.
Payout batches close at 16:00 Atlantic on business days.

On-call rotates weekly across the six engineers.

research.title: Carrier payment index, autumn issue
research.text:
Median days to pay a carrier fell from 31 to 27 across the brokers surveyed.
Factoring fees held at about 3% of invoice value.

research.title: Panel backgrounds
research.text:
Imre Solvang managed the reconciliation team before Settlements.
Asta Verhoeven wrote the idempotency layer for partner webhooks.
